decisions.reason: As a newly launched carpet close to the core assortment, with its own product page and no clear negative market signal in a growing industry, management would likely continue backing it rather than reverse a visible recent commitment.

This premium hand-knotted wool silk carpet fits the firm's design and materials positioning, and the recent launch plus public presentation make management inclined to justify and continue the investment.
Because it is a recent addition close to the established offer and was given its own page, escalation of commitment makes management likely to retain it absent clear evidence of failure.
The corner bench builds directly on the firm's furniture portfolio and serves residential and project interiors, so recent development effort and visible market commitment favor keeping it.

A low-pile carpet sits comfortably within the firm's broad interior range, and with only a short time on the market management can plausibly attribute any weak traction to normal ramp-up rather than abandon it.

The swivel shell chair is close to the firm's established seating offer and also aligns with its stated move toward flexible workplace concepts, making management especially likely to persist with it.
